content: The Standards of Care for children and adolescents with diabetes, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), encompass the management of type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, and other less common forms of diabetes. These include monogenic diabetes, such as Maturity-Onset Diabetes of the Young (MODY), and diabetes associated with cystic fibrosis, known as cystic fibrosis-related diabetes.
